summary: Noether Paper 30 source-quality verdict package. The package records that both the GDZ article PDF and the Internet Archive processed-JP2 article witness cover Paper 30, but both are effectively about 400 PPI and therefore do not unblock Paper 30 under the current 650+ PPI certification rule. This is a coordination/provenance package, not a corrected TeX branch and not Paper 30 source closure.
